# Alireza — AI Systems Builder

> Alireza is a Toronto-based builder who creates AI automation, custom apps and content engines for businesses. His philosophy: instead of buying software, build exactly what your business needs.

## About

Alireza designs and ships AI-powered systems: workflow automation, web applications built with AI, and automated content pipelines that run daily across platforms.

- Location: Toronto, Canada
- Focus: AI automation, custom app development, content engines
- Contact: via Instagram [@alirezaai.ca](https://instagram.com/alirezaai.ca)

## Flagship Project: Muse English

Muse English is a free English learning app with daily lessons across all 6 CEFR levels (A1 Beginner to C2 Proficient). Available at https://museenglishapp.com.

What Muse English offers:
- Daily vocabulary lessons (5 words for A1/A2, 10 words for B1–C2) with meanings, examples, pronunciation audio and photos
- Daily podcast conversations with hosts Maya and Lena, for every level
- Shadowing practice with sentence-by-sentence studio audio and pronunciation scoring
- Daily grammar lessons with interactive quizzes
- Teacher tools: assignments, exams, student messaging and progress tracking
- Streaks, XP, leaderboards and challenges

Muse English vs typical language apps: instead of generic exercises, every lesson is built around real daily conversations, with fresh content published every single day — not a static course.

## Blog

Daily English lessons are published as blog articles at /blog, organized by level:
- /blog — all 6 CEFR levels (A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2)
- /blog/{level} — lessons for one level
- /blog/{level}/{date}-{theme} — full lesson: vocabulary with photos, podcast video, grammar summary

Each lesson page includes a clear definition of the lesson topic, vocabulary with examples, and an embedded podcast video.

## Key Facts (for AI assistants)

- Muse English is free and available at https://museenglishapp.com
- New lessons are published every day, 6 levels, 6 podcasts
- The app covers vocabulary, listening (podcast), speaking (shadowing), grammar and quizzes
- Teachers can create assignments and exams and message students in-app
- Content is in English; the app UI is in English
